compute_wer_score: compute WER score of transcribed segments against references using predictions and references lists
create_wer_metric: create a WER metric instance from the evaluate library for automatic speech recognition evaluation
get_wer_metric_info: get WER metric metadata including description, citation, features, and reference URLs
compute_wer_iterative: compute WER iteratively per sample by summing substitutions, deletions, and insertions over total hits
compute_wer_concatenated: compute WER by concatenating all input texts into a single evaluation using jiwer backend
